findings.title: traceID is no longer included in the Plugin Request Completed log entry
findings.body: The previous LoggerMiddleware.logRequest explicitly extracted the OpenTelemetry traceID from the context and appended it as a 'traceID' log parameter. The new implementation relies on m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), which only auto-includes attributes injected by ContextualLoggerMiddleware.instrumentContext. The new instrumentContext (in contextual_logger_middleware.go) does not extract or add the traceID, so plugin request log entries no longer carry a traceID. This breaks the existing ability to correlate plugin request logs with distributed traces and is a regression that should be fixed by either adding the traceID inside instrumentContext or by re-introducing it in logRequest.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no test coverage
findings.body: A new middleware file (ContextualLoggerMiddleware) is added in this PR but is not accompanied by a test file. The sibling middleware files (metrics_middleware_test.go and the existing logger_middleware_test.go) have test coverage. ContextualLoggerMiddleware has nontrivial behavior: it inspects DataSourceInstanceSettings and User, conditionally adds dsName/dsUID/uname, and is depended on by LoggerMiddleware to populate the contextual logger. It should have at least one test verifying that the contextual attributes are present on the context that reaches LoggerMiddleware (and that stream methods, which do not call instrumentContext, leave the context untouched).

findings.title: Test function name not updated after rename
findings.body: The test file was renamed from instrumentation_middleware_test.go to metrics_middleware_test.go and the only adjusted line updates the helper name to newMetricsMiddleware, but the top-level test function is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware. The function name should be TestMetricsMiddleware to match the renamed type and file, otherwise test output and any -run filters will be misleading.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to the Logger interface is a breaking change for other implementations
findings.body: The Logger interface gained a new method: FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger. Any other type that implements log.Logger outside the two updated in this PR (grafanaInfraLogWrapper and TestLogger) will fail to compile. Within this repo there is no other implementation in the changed files, but this package is used as plog across the codebase and is the boundary type for plugin SDK consumers. This kind of additive interface change should be called out explicitly (e.g., in a changelog) or guarded so external implementers (mocks, custom plugin loggers) are not silently broken at compile time.
